next_label_sampling: U and V iid uniform on sorted vacant labels, with replacement; equality is allowed
suffix_sampling: Independent Fisher-Yates streams for each (N,prefix,quartet,group,replica); next label frozen; entire old ordered prefix retained
coupling: Within each new tail, both orientations use the same permutation; across the four tails conditional independence given prefix and U,V
stream_id: ((prefix_index*8+quartet)*8 + group*4 + slot); slot0 selects next label, slot1/2 generate independent suffixes; key=splitmix64(fork_seed XOR splitmix64((uint64(N)<<32)|stream_id))
observer: Full F1/F2/A/E at p_ref and after p integration; old nine joint checkpoint strata
next_rank: rank after exactly k0+1 insertions; R0->R2 is retained if it occurs
estimator: a=X_U0-X_V0,b=X_U1-X_V1; V=(aaT+bbT)/4; D=(abT+baT)/4; W=(a-b)(a-b)T/4; V=D+W per quartet
finite_sample_boundary: D is not forced PSD; no clipping.32-tail mean conditional covariance is D/16+W/32 in expectation, not V/32
inference_units: Same twenty original paired prefix batches per N, with new auxiliary suffix RNG. Not new independent prefix evidence
execution: Local C++ CPU, unchanged threshold-rank engine; no network DP, GPU or cloud startup
